notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ghave, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
When Saproling token enters the battlefield, Woodland Champion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Woodland Champion, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
Repeat from step 2.
